title: Adrenaline Drip
author: Ogato T.
desc: Push your limits with our weekly Adrenaline Drip program, designed for  intermediate athletes. Engage in 7 days of intense workouts focusing on strength and athleticism. Each 90 minute session includes a variety of exercises, featuring the Dumbbell Row as a key movement. Expect to enhance your performance and build muscle like never before.
